name: Calpe to Coll de Rates via Callosa & Tarbena
description: Inland from Calpe through Callosa d'en Sarrià and Tarbena to the Coll de Rates — the Costa Blanca's most famous climb. Used regularly in the Vuelta and by every pro training camp in the area.

name: Calpe Coastal & Coll de Rates Loop
description: 123km coastal route from Calpe combining the seaside road with the Coll de Rates climb. The full Calpe experience in one ride.

name: Calpe Coll de Rates Direct
description: Shortest approach to the Coll de Rates from Calpe. Up and over, through the Jalon Valley, and back via the coast.

name: Calpe, Benidorm & Finestrat Loop
description: Coastal loop south to Benidorm then inland through Finestrat and the Sierra Cortina. Good mix of flat coastal roads and punchy interior climbs.

name: Calpe 50mi Benidorm & Finestrat
description: 50-mile training loop from Calpe. South along the coast to Benidorm, inland through Finestrat, and back via the N332. The standard pro-camp Tuesday ride.

name: Calpe Coll de Rates Loop via Jalon
description: 77km loop from Calpe over the Coll de Rates returning through the Jalon Valley wine country. Quiet interior roads and a serious climb.
